description: Login timing attack protection enhancement - RED phase demonstrating vulnerability
execution_evidence: 1 test failed (expected), 50 passed. The RED test '[RED] should have similar timing for nonexistent user and wrong password paths' failed with: Expected: < 50, Received: 101 — confirming ~101ms timing difference between nonexistent user path (~103ms with fixed delay) and wrong password path (~2ms without delay). Second RED test '[RED] should prove that current code has a detectable timing difference' passed (101ms > 85ms threshold), confirming the vulnerability is detectable.
